en: A black‑and‑white image of a large wooden building in a park-like setting, photographed from ground level. The structure has a steeply pitched roof with extended, upturned gable ends resembling dragon heads or Viking ship prows, and elaborate wooden detailing along the eaves. It is elevated on a stone terrace or retaining wall, with trees and shrubs partially obscuring the facade. A paved path curves in the foreground and the sky is filled with scattered clouds. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
